notes: 把「支持哪些 git 云端」写清楚并去掉运行时的 Gitee 特化。同步链路本来就与平台无关：远端地址只校验写法，Gitee、GitHub、GitLab、自建 Gitea/Forgejo 走同一条 fetch/push/pull，三种写法 git@host:owner/repo.git、ssh://、https:// 都行，默认分支先试 main、云端没有就取远端第一个分支并自动建立 tracking。改动三处：①fetch/pull 失败的自检提示不再写死 ssh -T git@gitee.com，改为按 origin 的真实主机名现算（新增公共函数 Get-RemoteHost / Get-RemoteAuthHint）：SSH 地址给 ssh -T git@<host>，https 地址给 git ls-remote --heads origin（凭据交给 Git 凭据管理器），取不到主机名时给通用提示；②面板「远端地址」占位改成跨平台的 git@<host>:you/dsh-config.git，私钥占位去掉 _gitee 后缀，并新增脚注列出 Gitee / GitHub / GitLab / 自建 Gitea 四个平台与三个具体地址例子、区分 SSH 与 HTTPS 的认证方式；③README 中英各补一节「支持的云端平台 / Supported cloud hosts」，写明地址写法、分支识别、两种认证、100MB 单文件上限，以及私有库的已知限制（插件自身更新清单的 raw→API 转换目前只认 Gitee，私有 GitHub/GitLab 库的匿名 raw 读会失败）。自检同步加防线：selftest 新增 4 条断言盯住 gitee 硬编码不再回潮，clientcheck 里两条过期断言（按钮门禁还是老写法 noRepo）改成现行的 canPush / canPull / hasRepoPath 口径，自检恢复可跑。
notesEn: Spell out which git hosts are supported and remove the Gitee-specific bits from the runtime. The sync path was already platform-agnostic: the remote URL is only validated for its form, and Gitee, GitHub, GitLab and self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo take the same fetch/push/pull path; git@host:owner/repo.git, ssh:// and https:// are all accepted, main is tried first as the default branch, and the first remote branch is used (with tracking set up) when there is no main. Three changes: (1) a failed fetch/pull no longer tells everyone to run ssh -T git@gitee.com; the self-check hint is derived from the real origin host through two new common functions, Get-RemoteHost and Get-RemoteAuthHint - SSH URLs get ssh -T git@<host>, https URLs get git ls-remote --heads origin with the credential living in Git Credential Manager, and an unparsable URL gets a generic hint; (2) the Remote URL placeholder is now the cross-platform git@<host>:you/dsh-config.git, the key placeholder drops its _gitee suffix, and a new footnote lists Gitee / GitHub / GitLab / self-hosted Gitea with three concrete URL examples and the SSH-versus-HTTPS split; (3) both READMEs gain a Supported cloud hosts section covering URL forms, branch detection, the two auth modes, the 100MB per-file cap, and the known private-repo limitation (the plugin's own update manifest only rewrites Gitee raw links to the API+token form, so anonymous raw reads of a private GitHub/GitLab repo fail). Self-checks keep the line: four new selftest assertions guard against gitee hard-coding coming back, and two stale clientcheck assertions (the old noRepo button-gate wording) now match the live canPush / canPull / hasRepoPath expressions.
